message.content: Yuriko Yamamoto considers adding a user feedback section to her studio's homepage. This feedback section would allow her to gather insights from her clients about her services, thereby helping her improve her offerings and offering a more personalized approach to care. Additionally, she envisions incorporating a star rating system and testimonials to provide a more comprehensive understanding of the client experiences. This initiative aims to build trust among potential clients and further solidify her reputation in the field of speech therapy.
